lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of approximately 10 to 12 visible vertical columns of high-luminance circular blobs, each containing between 2 and 5 primary centroids, forming a structured grid-like arrangement posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity align with the vertical columns of circular blobs, creating distinct intersection points that form a repeating geometric matrix across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible along the upper flank. The superior-most ridge exhibits a sharp vertical gradient with high-intensity luminance on the dorsal aspect and a pronounced shadow vector on the ventral aspect.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits a sparse distribution of small, high-luminance blobs, primarily clustered toward the basal and leading-edge regions of the fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Two dark, elongated appendages consistent with remora attachment are visible on the ventral surface posterior to the right pectoral fin.
